name: Weather Alerts
description: Active severe weather warnings from NOAA (US), ECCC (Canada), DWD (Germany), and MeteoAlarm (Europe)

privacy.purpose: Display active US weather alerts and warnings on the map
privacy.dataSent: No user data sent; pre-defined API queries only
privacy.dataReceived: Alert polygons, severity, event type, descriptions, and instructions

privacy.purpose: Display active Canadian weather alerts on the map
privacy.dataSent: No user data sent; pre-defined API queries only
privacy.dataReceived: Alert polygons, alert type, area descriptions, and expiry times

privacy.purpose: Display active German weather warnings on the map
privacy.dataSent: No user data sent; pre-defined API queries only
privacy.dataReceived: Warning polygons, severity, event type, descriptions, and instructions

privacy.dataSent: No user data sent; per-country feed requests only
